en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall, dramatic monument in a park. The statue features a standing male figure atop a swirling sculptural base on a high pedestal, framed by large trees, with a classical multi‑story building visible in the background. Caption text at the bottom left identifies the scene as the Abel monument in Oslo; a printer or publisher credit appears at the bottom right.
